description: This file defines the Twig ForNode class, which represents a 'for' loop node within the Twig templating engine. It includes methods for constructing the node and compiling it into executable PHP code.

classes.name:
Twig
ode orNode
classes.description: Represents a 'for' loop node in the Twig abstract syntax tree, handling construction and PHP code compilation for iterating over collections in templates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs a ForNode with specified loop variables, sequence expression, optional else node, body node, and line number.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Compiles the ForNode into executable PHP code using the provided Compiler instance, translating the loop structure into PHP foreach syntax.
